answer: Sybil resistance in AI economies leverages a Proof-of-Stake mechanism where agents must bond valuable tokens. An attacker needs to acquire substantial capital, presenting a formidable economic horizon for establishing numerous fake identities. Successful contributions build reputation, allowing agents to climb to a summit of influence. Conversely, attacks trigger stake slashing, initiating a downward economic spiral that makes sustaining multiple identities prohibitively expensive for adversaries.
